title: Refactor clone-heavy Rust code then add Display impl — 3 turns
description: Code clones unnecessarily everywhere. Reduce clones, keep tests green, add Display impl.

task_spec.prompt:
Refactor `Config` in `src/lib.rs` to reduce unnecessary clones:
1. Change `get_name()` to return `&str` instead of `String`
2. Change `get_tags()` to return `&[String]` instead of `Vec<String>`
3. Fix `summary()` to not clone name or tags before using them in format!
4. Fix `has_tag()` to compare `t.as_str() == tag` instead of cloning
Run `cargo test --quiet` to confirm no regressions.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: implement `std::fmt::Display` for `Config`. Format it as `Config{name} (value=N, tags=[t1, t2])`. Then run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm everything is green — all 4 tests must pass.
success_criteria: summary and has_tag don't clone unnecessarily
